name: Shenzhen GSIN Green Building CO.,LTD
tagline: Steel structure engineering: super high-rise, large-span space and prefabricated steel buildings
description: Founded in 1998 and based in Longgang District, Shenzhen, GSIN builds and constructs super high-rise steel structures, large-span space steel structures and prefabricated steel structure buildings. It has developed a business system featuring professional design, factory-based manufacturing and standardized installation, and on this basis has grown into urban operation building products and steel-structure villa residence products.
